name: ask_vapi_docs
description: Ask about current Vapi documentation through the Fern docs MCP. Returns relevant documentation passages and source URLs; use them to answer the question.

question.description: A specific question about Vapi configuration, APIs, SDKs or troubleshooting. Send no API keys or private customer data.

topK.description: Maximum number of relevant documentation passages.

name: create_assistant
description: Creates a new Vapi assistant

firstMessage.default: Hello, how can I help you today?
firstMessage.description: First message to say to the user

firstMessageMode.description: This determines who speaks first, either assistant or user

toolIds.description: IDs of tools to use with this assistant

name: create_call
description: Creates a outbound call

assistantId.description: ID of the assistant to use for the call

variableValues.description: Key-value pairs for dynamic variables to use in the assistant's prompts (e.g. {"name": "Joe", "age": "24"})

phoneNumberId.description: ID of the phone number to use for the call

scheduledAt.description: ISO datetime string for when the call should be scheduled (e.g. "2025-03-25T22:39:27.771Z")

name: create_simulation
description: Creates a simulation that pairs a scenario with a personality. Run it with run_simulations.

name.description: This is an optional friendly name for the simulation.

path.description:
Optional folder path for organizing simulations.
Supports up to 3 levels (e.g., "dept/feature/variant").
Maps to GitOps resource folder structure.

personalityId.description: This is the ID of the personality to use for this simulation.

scenarioId.description: This is the ID of the scenario to use for this simulation.

name: create_simulation_personality
description: Creates a simulation personality: the simulated caller that talks to the assistant under test

assistant.description: Full tester assistant configuration, validated against the bundled Vapi OpenAPI schema. See https://api.vapi.ai/api-json (TransientAssistantDTO).

name.description: This is the name of the personality (e.g., "Confused Carl", "Rude Rob").

path.description:
Optional folder path for organizing personalities.
Supports up to 3 levels (e.g., "dept/feature/variant").
Maps to GitOps resource folder structure.

name: create_simulation_scenario
description: Creates a simulation scenario: instructions for the tester plus evaluations that decide whether the assistant passed

additionalFields.description: Additional documented API fields. The merged request is validated against the bundled Vapi OpenAPI schema.

evaluations.description:
This is the structured output-based evaluation plan for the simulation.
Each item defines a structured output to extract and evaluate against an expected value.

path.description: Optional dot-notation path to a primitive leaf when evaluating an object structured output.

required.description:
This is whether this evaluation must pass for the simulation to pass.
Defaults to true. If false, the result is informational only.

structuredOutput.description: Full structuredOutput configuration, validated against the bundled Vapi OpenAPI schema. See https://api.vapi.ai/api-json.

structuredOutputId.description:
This is the ID of an existing structured output to use for evaluation.
Mutually exclusive with structuredOutput.

value.description:
This is the expected value to compare against the extracted structured output result.
Type should match the structured output's schema type.

instructions.description: This is the script/instructions for the tester to follow during the simulation.

name.description: This is the name of the scenario.

path.description:
Optional folder path for organizing scenarios.
Supports up to 3 levels (e.g., "dept/feature/variant").
Maps to GitOps resource folder structure.

name: create_simulation_suite
description: Creates a simulation suite that groups simulations so they can be run together

additionalFields.description: Additional documented API fields. The merged request is validated against the bundled Vapi OpenAPI schema.

name.description: This is the name of the simulation suite.

path.description:
Optional folder path for organizing simulation suites.
Supports up to 3 levels (e.g., "dept/feature/variant").
Maps to GitOps resource folder structure.

simulationIds.description: This is the list of simulation IDs to include in the suite.

name: create_tool
description: Creates a new Vapi tool

apiRequest.description: API Request tool configuration - for HTTP API integration

backoffPlan.description: Retry configuration for failed API requests

baseDelaySeconds.description: Base delay between retries in seconds

type.description:
This is the type of backoff plan to use. Defaults to fixed.

@default fixed

body.description: Body schema for the API request in JSON Schema format

description.description: This is the description to help the model understand what it needs to output.

enum.description: This array specifies the allowed values that can be used to restrict the output of the model.

properties.description: This is required if the type is "object". This specifies the properties of the object. This is a map of property names to JsonSchema objects.

required.description:
This is a list of properties that are required.

This only makes sense if the type is "object".

title.description: This is the title of the schema.

headers.description: Headers to send with the request (key-value pairs)

method.description: HTTP method for the API request

url.description: URL to make the API request to

description.description: Description of what the function/tool does

function.description: Custom function tool configuration - for custom server-side functions

required.description: This specifies the properties that are required by the function.

type.description: This must be set to 'object'. It instructs the model to return a JSON object containing the function call properties.

server.description: Server configuration with URL where the function will be called

headers.description: Headers to send with the request

url.description: Server URL where the function will be called

sms.description: SMS tool configuration - to send text messages

from.description: Phone number to send SMS from (e.g., "+15551234567"). It must be a twilio number in E.164 format.

transferCall.description: Transfer call tool configuration - to transfer calls to destinations

items.description: Transfer destination. Other TransferDestinationNumber fields, such as transferPlan and message, are sent as given (see get_api_schema).

description.description: This is the description of the destination, used by the AI to choose when and how to transfer the call.

extension.description: This is the extension to dial after transferring the call to the `number`.

number.description: This is the phone number to transfer the call to.

anyOf.description: The type of tool. "sms" for Twilio SMS sending tool.
The type of tool. "function" for Function tool.
The type of tool. "apiRequest" for API request tool.

type.description: Type of the tool to create

name: get_api_schema
description: Looks up a schema in the Vapi API reference (the OpenAPI spec the Vapi SDKs are generated from). Pass `search` to find schema names, then `name` to get one schema. References to other schemas are left as "#/components/schemas/<Name>" and listed in referencedSchemas, so look those up next if you need them. Use it to find fields that other tools accept through additionalFields.

name.description: Exact schema name to return, e.g. "CreateTransferCallToolDTO" or "TransferPlan"

search.description: Case-insensitive text to find schema names, e.g. "transfer". Used when name is not given.

name: get_assistant
description: Gets a Vapi assistant by ID

assistantId.description: ID of the assistant to get

name: get_call
description: Gets details of a specific call

callId.description: ID of the call to get

name: get_phone_number
description: Gets details of a specific phone number

phoneNumberId.description: ID of the phone number to get

name: get_simulation_run
description: Gets a simulation run with its status, item counts, and the first 100 item summaries. itemsTruncated indicates omitted items; itemsMetadata preserves API pagination metadata. Use get_simulation_run_item for an item’s transcript and call details.

name: get_simulation_run_item
description: Gets one simulation run item in full, including results, call snapshots, transcript, and improvement suggestions

name: get_tool
description: Gets details of a specific tool

toolId.description: ID of the tool to get

name: list_assistants
description: Lists up to 10 Vapi assistants

name: list_calls
description: Lists up to 10 Vapi calls

name: list_phone_numbers
description: Lists up to 10 Vapi phone numbers

name: list_simulation_personalities
description: Lists simulation personalities: the simulated callers (testers) used in Vapi simulations

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 50)

name: list_simulation_runs
description: Lists simulation runs, newest first

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 50)

name: list_simulation_scenarios
description: Lists simulation scenarios: the scripts testers follow and the checks that decide pass or fail

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 50)

name: list_simulation_suites
description: Lists simulation suites: named groups of simulations

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 50)

name: list_simulations
description: Lists simulations. Each simulation pairs one scenario with one personality.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 50)

name: list_tools
description: Lists up to 10 Vapi tools

name: load_skill
description: Read a public Vapi skill or one of its supporting files. Start with SKILL.md, then load relevant files from the returned file list as needed. Returns instructions for this task; does not install skills or execute scripts.

path.description: File path relative to the skill directory, such as SKILL.md or references/hooks.md.

name: run_simulations
description: Starts a simulation run of simulations and/or suites against an assistant or squad. Returns the run with its ID and a dashboard URL to share with the user. Check progress with get_simulation_run.

assistantId.description: ID of an existing assistant to test against. Cannot be combined with inline assistant.

iterations.description: Number of times to run each simulation (default: 1)

items.description: ID of an existing simulation to run. When provided, scenarioId/personalityId/inline fields are ignored.

squadId.description: ID of an existing squad to test against. Cannot be combined with inline squad.

items.description: ID of the simulation suite to run

transport.description: Transport provider for the simulation run

name: search_skills
description: Find Vapi agent skills in the public VapiAI/skills repository by name, description or content. Omit query to browse. Use load_skill to read a result.

query.description: Keywords describing the Vapi task, or empty to browse all skills.
